Rivet overrides bookmarklet

Drag this link to your bookmarks bar:

Rivet overrides

  1. Run npm run serve (serves the CSS at http://localhost:8777/overrides.css, rebuilt on every request).
  2. Open any page and click the bookmark to apply the overrides; click again to remove them.
  3. After editing a CSS file, click twice (off, on) to reload the latest version.

Mode: server (localhost:8777). Pages with a strict Content-Security-Policy can block injected styles.
